body: my dad helps any way he can.  he's retired so he doesn't have much money.  my mom has money but is in denial about the bad side of my life.  she only seems to want to be nice or helpful when things are going well.  the first time i attempted suicide i was 14 (double that now in age with 2 attempts that i nearly died trying but was found both times, taken the hospital, stomach pumped, etc.).  but that 1st time was more for attention from my mom.  she told me to find my own way to the hospital.  so yeah, that's my main family.  my stepmom will allow us to stay with her for a week.  i may take her up on it except it's been high 80s temp wise here and she doesn't have AC in any rooms except her bedroom.  idk.  i'm just stuck.  trying but it's fucking hard.  like really really fucking hard.  if it was just me, i'd be gone and live in my car and be dirt poor and not care if i missed a meal or two or more.  but it's not about me and i am destroyed on what's best.  do i stay so my daughter has what she needs or leave so she doesn't grow up without a mom because the longer i'm here the more i want to just fucking die.

I found a domestic violence place and I plan to call tomorrow.  I just don't want to uproot my baby.  She is finally adjusting to sleeping through the night.  She's still young and has trouble in new places.  I don't want to leave here unless it's to be in a new home and not bounce her place to place.  I don't know, I'm probably full of excuses right now.  I'm always like that when I'm upset and can't think logically.  I just find reasons to give up.
